_about: Public-domain Narsai (d. c.502), head of the School of Nisibis and poet of the Church of the East, for the Word Hoard: The Liturgical Homilies of Narsai, translated by R. H. Connolly with an appendix by Edmund Bishop (Texts and Studies, Cambridge, 1909), from an Internet Archive scan. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 38 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

narsai-liturgical-homilies-1909: The Liturgical Homilies of Narsai, tr. R. H. Connolly, with an appendix by Edmund Bishop, Texts and Studies VIII.1 (Cambridge: University Press, 1909)

_excluded.narsai-other: Mingana's Syriac edition (1905) and later Syriac printings
